name: Major Triad
description: Root, Major 3rd, Perfect 5th. Foundational consonant triad (I, IV, V).

name: Minor Triad
description: Root, Minor 3rd, Perfect 5th. Core minor triad (ii, iii, vi).

name: Suspended 2nd
description: Replaces the 3rd with a Major 2nd for an open, airy modal sound.

name: Suspended 4th
description: Replaces the 3rd with a Perfect 4th, creating tension that resolves to Major/Minor.

name: Diminished Triad
description: Root, Minor 3rd, Diminished 5th (tritone). Found on degree vii°.

name: Augmented Triad
description: Symmetrical triad stacking two Major 3rds (Root, 3, #5).

name: Power Chord (5th)
description: Root, Perfect 5th, and Octave without a 3rd. Ambiguous major/minor quality.

name: Major Flat-5 Triad
description: Major 3rd with a lowered 5th (Lydian tritone color).

name: Major Add 9
description: Major triad with an added 9th (no 7th). Staple of pop and acoustic harmony.

name: Minor Add 9
description: Minor triad with an added Major 9th (no 7th). Cinematic minor color.

name: Major Add 11
description: Major triad with an added Perfect 4th/11th cluster.

name: Minor Add 11
description: Minor triad with an added 11th (no 7th).

name: Dominant 7th
description: Major triad with a minor 7th. Found on degree V7 of Major (Mixolydian).

name: Major 7th
description: Major triad with a Major 7th. Warm tonic/subdominant chord (Ionian, Lydian).

name: Minor 7th
description: Minor triad with a minor 7th. Core jazz ii-7 / vi-7 chord (Dorian, Aeolian).

name: Minor-Major 7th
description: Minor triad with a Major 7th. Tonic of Harmonic and Melodic Minor.

name: Half-Diminished 7th
description: Diminished triad with a minor 7th. Minor iiø7 cadence chord (Locrian).

name: Diminished 7th
description: Symmetrical stack of minor 3rds (0, 3, 6, 9). Classic passing and vii°7 chord.

name: Dominant 7th Suspended 4th
description: Dominant 7th with a 4th replacing the 3rd. Herbie Hancock / modal funk staple.

name: Dominant 7th Suspended 2nd
description: Dominant 7th with a Major 2nd replacing the 3rd.

name: Major 6th
description: Major triad with a Major 6th (13th). Classic swing and bossa tonic.

name: Minor 6th
description: Minor triad with a Major 6th. Characteristic Dorian and melodic minor tonic.

name: Major 7th Sharp-5
description: Augmented triad with a Major 7th. III+maj7 of Melodic/Harmonic Minor.

name: Major 7th Flat-5
description: Major 7th with a lowered 5th (#11/b5 Lydian color).

name: Dominant 9th
description: Dominant 7th plus Major 9th. Essential funk, blues, and jazz dominant.

name: Major 9th
description: Major 7th plus Major 9th. Lush contemporary jazz and neo-soul tonic.

name: Minor 9th
description: Minor 7th plus Major 9th. Smooth Dorian ii-9 / vi-9 voicing.

name: Minor-Major 9th
description: Minor-Major 7th with an added Major 9th. Melodic minor tonic extension.

name: Dominant 9th Suspended 4th
description: Suspended dominant with 4th, b7th, and 9th (equivalent to IV/V slash chord).

name: Minor 11th
description: Minor 9th with a Perfect 11th. Iconic modal jazz & quartal harmony chord.

name: Major 11th
description: Major 9th with a natural 11th.

name: Dominant 13th
description: Dominant 9th with a Major 13th (6th above octave). Rich Mixolydian V13.

name: Major 13th
description: Major 9th with an added Major 13th.

name: Minor 13th
description: Minor 9th with a Dorian Major 13th.

name: Dominant 13th Suspended 4th
description: Full gospel/fusion suspended dominant with 4th, b7, 9, and 13.

name: Major 6/9
description: Major triad with 6th and 9th (pentatonic tonic voicing).

name: Minor 6/9
description: Minor triad with Major 6th and Major 9th. Classic jazz-noir tonic.

name: Dominant 7th Add 13
description: Dominant 7th with a 13th and no 9th.

name: Dominant 7th Flat-5
description: Dominant 7th with a lowered 5th (tritone substitution / Whole-Tone color).

name: Dominant 7th Sharp-5
description: Augmented dominant 7th (Whole-Tone / Altered dominant).

name: Dominant 7th Flat-9
description: Dominant 7th with a minor 9th (13 semitones). Resolves strongly to Minor or Major.

name: Dominant 7th Sharp-9
description: Dominant 7th with an augmented 9th (15 semitones). Blues/fusion 'Hendrix' chord.

name: Dominant 7th Sharp-11 (Lydian Dom)
description: Dominant 7th with a #11th (18 semitones). IV7 of Melodic Minor (Lydian Dominant).

name: Dominant 7th Flat-13
description: Dominant 7th with a minor 13th (20 semitones). V7 of Harmonic/Melodic Minor.

name: Altered Dominant 7th
description: Root, 3rd, b7th, b9th, and #9th (Super-Locrian / Altered scale).

name: Major 7th Sharp-11 (Lydian)
description: Major 7th with an augmented 11th (18 semitones). Signature Lydian mode chord.

name: Major 9th Sharp-11
description: Full Lydian Major 9th with #11.

name: Dominant 9th Sharp-11
description: Lydian Dominant 9th (Root, 3, 5, b7, 9, #11).

name: Dominant 9th Flat-5
description: Dominant 9th with a lowered 5th.

name: Dominant 9th Sharp-5
description: Whole-Tone Dominant 9th with an augmented 5th.

name: Dominant 7th Flat-9 Flat-5
description: Altered / Half-Whole Diminished dominant with b5 and b9.

name: Dominant 7th Flat-9 Sharp-5
description: Altered dominant with augmented 5th (b13) and flat 9th.

name: Dominant 7th Sharp-9 Flat-5
description: Altered dominant with lowered 5th and sharp 9th.

name: Dominant 7th Sharp-9 Sharp-5
description: Richly altered dominant with #5 (b13) and #9.

name: Dominant 13th Flat-9
description: Half-Whole Diminished dominant combining b9 and natural 13th.

name: Dominant 13th Sharp-11
description: Full Lydian Dominant 13#11 voicing.

name: Half-Diminished 9th
description: Half-diminished 7th with a natural 9th (Locrian ♮2).

name: Half-Diminished 11th
description: Half-diminished 9th with an added 11th.

name: Phrygian Minor 7th Flat-9
description: Minor 7th with a Phrygian b9 (b2) tension.

name: Major 1st Inversion (Over 3rd)
description: Major triad with its Major 3rd (+4 semitones) in the bass (e.g. C/E).

name: Major 2nd Inversion (Over 5th)
description: Major triad with its Perfect 5th (+7 semitones) in the bass (e.g. C/G).

name: Minor 1st Inversion (Over b3)
description: Minor triad with its Minor 3rd (+3 semitones) in the bass (e.g. Am/C).

name: Major Triad Over 2nd (IV/V Soul Grip)
description: Major triad over the whole-step above root (e.g. C/D = D9sus4).

name: Major Triad Over b7
description: Major triad with a minor 7th in the bass (e.g. C/Bb).

name: Minor Triad Over 4th
description: Minor triad over a Perfect 4th bass pedal (e.g. Am/D).

name: Minor 7th Over b7 (3rd Inversion)
description: Minor 7th with its b7 in the bass for smooth descending basslines (e.g. Am7/G).
